globalAttributes.name: hx-boost
globalAttributes.description: Boost normal links and forms to use AJAX requests.

globalAttributes.name: hx-confirm
globalAttributes.description: Show a confirmation dialog before issuing the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-delete
globalAttributes.description: Issue a DELETE request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disable
globalAttributes.description: Disable htmx processing for this element and its children.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disabled-elt
globalAttributes.description: Disable selected elements while a request is in flight.

globalAttributes.name: hx-disinherit
globalAttributes.description: Control which inherited htmx attributes should not be inherited.

globalAttributes.name: hx-encoding
globalAttributes.description: Set the request encoding type, such as multipart/form-data.

globalAttributes.name: hx-ext
globalAttributes.description: Enable one or more htmx extensions for this element.

globalAttributes.name: hx-get
globalAttributes.description: Issue a GET request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-headers
globalAttributes.description: Add request headers using a JSON object.

globalAttributes.name: hx-history
globalAttributes.description: Control whether the page is saved in the history cache.

globalAttributes.name: hx-history-elt
globalAttributes.description: Mark the element whose content should be saved in the history cache.

globalAttributes.name: hx-include
globalAttributes.description: Include additional elements in request parameter collection.

globalAttributes.name: hx-indicator
globalAttributes.description: Select the element that receives the htmx-request class while loading.

globalAttributes.name: hx-on
globalAttributes.description: Attach inline event handlers for htmx or DOM events.

globalAttributes.name: hx-params
globalAttributes.description: Filter submitted request parameters.

globalAttributes.name: hx-patch
globalAttributes.description: Issue a PATCH request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-post
globalAttributes.description: Issue a POST request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-preserve
globalAttributes.description: Preserve this element by id between content swaps.

globalAttributes.name: hx-prompt
globalAttributes.description: Show a prompt before issuing the request and submit the result.

globalAttributes.name: hx-push-url
globalAttributes.description: Push a URL into browser history after a successful request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-put
globalAttributes.description: Issue a PUT request to the given URL.

globalAttributes.name: hx-replace-url
globalAttributes.description: Replace the current browser history URL after a successful request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-request
globalAttributes.description: Configure request behavior using a JSON object.

globalAttributes.name: hx-select
globalAttributes.description: Select the fragment to swap from the server response.

globalAttributes.name: hx-select-oob
globalAttributes.description: Select content to swap out of band from the server response.

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap
globalAttributes.description: Control how the response is swapped into the target element.

globalAttributes.name: hx-swap-oob
globalAttributes.description: Swap this element out of band into another part of the document.

globalAttributes.name: hx-sync
globalAttributes.description: Synchronize requests between elements.

globalAttributes.name: hx-target
globalAttributes.description: Select the element that receives the swapped response.

globalAttributes.name: hx-trigger
globalAttributes.description: Specify the event or events that trigger the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-vals
globalAttributes.description: Add request values using a JSON object.

globalAttributes.name: hx-validate
globalAttributes.description: Force validation before issuing the request.

globalAttributes.name: hx-vars
globalAttributes.description: Add dynamically computed request values.
